title: Fundamental Gaps for the Dirichlet p-Laplacian on Convex Domains
summary: We study the fundamental gap of the Dirichlet $p$-Laplacian on bounded convex domains. We first prove the sharp one-dimensional estimate $Γ_p(I_D,V)\ge (p-1)(2^p-1)(π_p/D)^p$, $I_D=(-D/2,D/2)$, for all $1 2$, $G_{p,N}>0$ and the infimum is attained. We obtain explicit dimension-dependent bounds and $G_{p,N}\asymp_p N^{p-2}$ as $N\to\infty$, while for fixed $N$, $\lim_{p\downarrow2}G_{p,N}=3π^2$ and $\lim_{p\to\infty}G_{p,N}^{1/p}=4$.
